designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Balcones Canyonlands National Wildlife Refuge under the Endangered Species Act to protect golden-cheeked warbler and black-capped vireo habitat.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Balcones Canyonlands National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
USFWS, Balcones Canyonlands National Wildlife Refuge Hunt Plan (ServCat 117376): "established in February, 1992, under the authority of the Endangered Species Act of 1973"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Balcones Canyonlands National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1992.
